job_description_raw:
Mô tả công việc
Position Purpose
Key accountabilities - the purpose of this position?
1	Ensure Internal Controls are performed as per the company’s internal policies and regulations.
2	Support with the reporting of internal control results to auditees
3	Support departments to improve compliance work and process efficiency
4	Support other team members in APAC region to perform audit outside Vietnam. (APAC region)
5	Able to understand and support auditee with latest process update
Specific Tasks
Core position tasks – the tasks required to achieve the Position Purpose. What are the tasks?
1	Plan and schedule audit work with relevant departments
2	Perform audit assignments correctly and completely as per scheduled
3	Provide periodic audit progress updates to the senior auditor & manager
4	Complete audit working files correctly and on timely basis
5	Support the development and implementation of internal control process for local GBs and other divisions
6	Internal review of measure reports with IC teams and provide support for local GBs
7	Conduct review on existing local processes and suggest for best practice / improvement if required
8	Conduct a follow up on previous audit deficiency
9	Support senior and other team members on ad hoc basis
10	Stay up with latest updates on IC topics relevant to GS and other divisions
job_requirements_raw:
Yêu cầu ứng viên
- Language – English, Vietnamese, Korean (preferred)
- Work Experience – Audit firm (1-2 years). If possible, from big 4 or international audit firm
- IT Skill – SAP, Microsoft (excel, word, power point)
